sections.title: Overview
sections.text_preview: The File Handling subtopology packages the core file-transfer and file-management services commonly needed in F Prime deployments into a single reusable unit. It provides file uplink (ground to flight

sections.title: Included Components
sections.text_preview:
- **File Uplink** (active) — Receives file packets from the communication stack and reconstructs files on the flight file system.
- **File Downlink** (active) — Reads files from the file system, segme

sections.title: Required Inputs
sections.text_preview:
- Rate group connections to drive File Downlink's send cycle.
- Communication stack connections for file packet exchange (wire to a ComFprime or ComCcsds subtopology's file ports).
- Parameter connect

sections.title: Configuration
sections.text_preview:
- Base IDs, queue sizes, stack sizes, and priorities via FileHandlingConfig.
- The File Downlink send rate is determined by the connected rate group frequency.

sections.title: Limitations
sections.text_preview: This subtopology focuses on file transfer, file operations, and parameter management. It does not provide framing, deframing, or CDH services — those are provided by the communication and CDH subtopol
